description: Why did my game crash? Reads the newest crash log (or one you paste or point at), says in plain words what happened, and lists the names the log points at, ranked, each with its reason and a label for what it rests on: the log itself, your install, a published rule, or ModWrench's own guess. A ranking is a lead, never a verdict. Also checks the setup for the usual causes (for Skyrim Special Edition: game version, SKSE build, Address Library and plugin DLLs), for a Crash Logger SSE or Buffout 4 log, compares your other recent crashes to see whether it keeps happening, and writes posts to ask for help with (forum, GitHub, Discord, or the mod's author) with the personal details it recognises (your name, computer name, folders, addresses, keys) taken out; it can miss things, so read a post before you send it. Handles Crash Logger SSE, Buffout 4, NetScriptFramework and BepInEx logs. Local and read-only — nothing is written or kept, and ModWrench sends nothing anywhere; the answer goes to the AI you're talking to. Call it with no arguments to read the newest crash log. When the user names a log file, pass it as logPath instead of reading the file into the conversation first: ModWrench takes out the personal details it recognises before the answer reaches the AI. Use when the user says "my game crashed", "CTD", "why did it crash", "which mod is it", or "help me post about this crash".

checkInstall.description: Check the log against the player's install (Skyrim Special Edition so far). Default true. False reads the log alone.

compareRecent.description: How many of the player's other recent crash logs to compare, to see whether the same name keeps coming up (Crash Logger SSE and Buffout 4 logs only; NetScriptFramework and BepInEx logs aren't compared). Default 5; 0 skips it.

gameId.description: Which game to look for a log of: skyrimspecialedition, fallout4, lethalcompany and the other games ModWrench knows. Default: whichever game's log is newest.

gamePath.description: The install folder, when ModWrench can't find the game on its own — a GOG copy, or a Steam library in an unusual place. Used with gameId.

hideNames.description: Leave the plugin lists (plugins, SKSE or F4SE plugins, DLLs) out of the help posts, for someone who'd rather not share what they run. The leads, the call stack, and the objects, game files and Papyrus functions the log names, with every plugin that changed those objects, still appear.

logContent.description: The crash log's text, if the user pasted it. Leave it out to read the newest crash log from disk. Up to about 4 MB.

logPath.description: A crash log file, if it isn't where the crash logger normally writes it. Leave it out and ModWrench looks for the newest one.

logType.description: Format hint. Default 'auto' — detect from the content. Pass one when a truncated log can't be told apart.

mo2InstancePath.description: Mod Organizer 2 instance folder, for a portable instance that doesn't live where MO2 normally keeps them.

packet.description: Put the ready-to-post help text for this place into the answer. Without it the answer says the posts are ready and the page offers them.

profileName.description: MO2 profile name. Default: the instance's active profile.

name: mw_crash_whisperer
title: Why did my game crash?
